create_VideoMAEImageProcessor: create a VideoMAEImageProcessor instance to preprocess video frames for VideoMAE models
preprocess_videos_frames: preprocess a video or batch of videos by resizing, center cropping, rescaling, and normalizing frames
prepare_images_structure: prepare nested image structures from video frames with expected tensor dimensions
resize_video_frames: resize video frames to a target size using bilinear resampling while grouping by shape
stack_video_pixel_values: stack processed per-video frames into batched pixel value tensors for model input
